items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yes, there was Carl White... and Willie Lynch, he played drums. ... Willie Lynch had the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the guys who were with you in those days?

Yes, there was Carl White -- he played the banjo and he sang. Leroy Tibbs played the tenor saxophone. Clarence Cummings, he played the violin, and Willie Lynch, he played drums. You probably know Willie Lynch, he used to play at the Savoy, he had that big band, you know, when the Savoy opened? Willie Lynch had the band.
I was just gonna ask you did any of those guys ever make it to New York?
